criterion: (v) realized funding APR of a paper trade (>= 7 days held, not deferred) within [p05, p95] of its entry bucket

definition.realized_funding_apr: funding collected (fraction of slot notional) / (days held / 365)
definition.slot_notional: A: spot entry price x qty; B: leg A (Binance) entry price x qty; $2000 per leg in the paper book
definition.price_at_payment: close of the 4h bar containing the payment (backtest convention; the paper engine does the same)
definition.percentiles: linear interpolation between order statistics (numpy default / R type 7)
definition.merge: bucket with < 10 trades merged into its lower neighbour (lowest into upper), repeated top-down
definition.pass: >= 80 % of paper trades (>= 7 days, not deferred) inside their bucket's band; needs >= 10 such trades

A.universe_filter: Binance USDT-M PERPETUAL, underlyingType == COIN (TradFi excluded), active, Binance USDT spot exists

A.primary_sample: trades held >= 7 days, no funding gap in the holding window, open-at-end included

B.primary_sample: trades held >= 7 days, no funding gap in the holding window, open-at-end included
